description: Identify the HonkIO account the configured API key belongs to: the account (ID, name, credit balance, status) and its list of API keys (each with its own prefix, mode and label). It does not say which of those keys is the one you are calling with (the API never identifies the calling key back to itself), so track your own key's mode (mk_live_... or mk_test_...) separately. Call this first when you need an account ID.
name: whoami
title: Who am I
